## 1. What is AR Membership Manager? (Definition Block)
AR Membership Manager is an automated dues collection and ledger system designed for gyms, yoga studios, tuition centres, and sports academies in India. It replaces manual spreadsheet tracking by scheduling automated 9:00 AM WhatsApp renewal reminders with 1-tap UPI payment links, updating member renewal dates in real time with 0% platform transaction cuts.

---

## 2. Core Problem & Solution
- **The Problem**: Over 12% to 15% of membership revenue in gyms and fitness studios is delayed each month due to forgotten renewal dates. Front-desk staff spend 1–2 hours every day manually checking Excel spreadsheets, typing awkward WhatsApp messages, and matching bank UPI screenshots.
- **The Solution**: AR Membership connects your member list to the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API and Cashfree payment gateway. The system monitors membership expiration dates and dispatches personalized WhatsApp reminders with pre-filled 1-tap UPI payment links. When a member pays, their status is updated to Paid and their membership extends automatically.

---

## 3. Automated 3-Stage Reminder Cadence
Reminders dispatch automatically at 9:00 AM Indian Standard Time:

1. **Stage 1: Advance Notice (-3 Days Before Expiry)**
   - Friendly courtesy message informing the member their renewal is due in 3 days.
   - Includes their personalized 1-tap UPI payment link.
2. **Stage 2: Due Date Notice (Day of Expiry)**
   - Branded renewal prompt notifying the member that their subscription renews today to prevent service interruption.
3. **Stage 3: Overdue Follow-up (+3 Days Overdue)**
   - Gentle reminder with the direct payment link. If payment is received, late renewals renew from the actual payment date rather than lost past days.

---

## 4. Manual Spreadsheets vs. AR Membership Manager (Comparison Table)

| Feature | Manual Spreadsheets & Personal WhatsApp | AR Membership Manager |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Reminder Dispatch** | Manual typing (1-2 hours daily) | Automated 9:00 AM WhatsApp notices via official Cloud API |
| **Payment Collection** | QR code screenshots & manual bank check | Instant 1-tap UPI payment link with dynamic transaction ID |
| **Ledger Updates** | Manual entry into Excel or Google Sheets | Real-time automated ledger update upon payment webhook |
| **Number Safety** | High risk of WhatsApp ban on personal SIM | Zero risk of bans (Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API) |
| **Late Renewals** | Prone to dispute / lost days | Fair renewal calculated from payment date |
| **Data Ownership** | Fragmented on front-desk laptops | 100% private Cloudflare instance and database |
| **Platform Cost** | High staff overhead & delayed cashflow | ₹14,999 Lifetime License (₹0/mo recurring) |

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Do I need any coding or technical knowledge to run AR?
A: None whatsoever. We handle 100% of the initial configuration, cloud database setup, Meta WhatsApp API verification, and Cashfree payment linking. You receive a ready-to-use dashboard that works on desktop, tablet, and mobile like any standard web app.

### Q: Can I use my existing business WhatsApp number?
A: Yes. You can use your existing phone number or a dedicated new SIM. We register it under the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API so you get high delivery rates, official green tick compatibility, and zero risk of personal number bans.

### Q: What if a member pays by cash or offline at the reception?
A: Simply click 'Mark Paid' on their member card in your dashboard. You can choose to extend their membership +1 Month from today or from their original renewal date, and AR will automatically send them a branded WhatsApp confirmation confirming payment.

### Q: How does payment tracking work? Does AR take a cut?
A: AR never touches your funds. For Cashfree checkout payments, transactions and renewals are automatically marked in real-time. For direct 0% fee UPI QR or cash payments, you simply click 'Mark Paid' in one tap. All funds settle straight into your own bank account.

### Q: Can I import our existing members from Excel or Google Sheets?
A: Yes. We provide a 1-click CSV/Excel importer. If you send us your existing member list during setup, our onboarding team will format and upload all your members for you at no additional charge.

### Q: What happens when an expired member renews late?
A: With AR, late renewals are fair and automatic: an expired member renews from the day they actually pay, not the expired past date. You can also override or adjust this with custom billing dates at any time.
